name: page batch hash GROUP BY -- qexec_batch_gby_flush () replays the row path for the pending rows of cached groups (per-group row order, LRU touch by last row, the selectivity check at the row path's tuple counts) and qexec_gby_cache_add () keeps at most 512 entries with one key copy each and one entry a group
fakes: No seam. hooks.cpp builds a QEXEC_BATCH_GBY, an AGGREGATE_HASH_CONTEXT and a zeroed XASL_NODE by hand (cache entries at chosen slots, pend_row/pend_ent as qexec_batch_gby_consume () leaves them before a flush) and calls the real qexec_batch_gby_flush (), qexec_gby_cache_add (), qexec_gby_cache_find (), qexec_gby_cache_clear () and, through the abandon, the real qexec_hash_gby_selectivity_abandons () / qexec_hash_gby_abandon (). Fakes of other TUs: qdata_evaluate_aggregate_batch () records batch->sel/n_sel and alt_acc_list (the group); qdata_get_agg_hvalue_size () returns 0 (the batch's aggregates are fixed-width: their accumulators never change size, so the real function's delta is 0 too); mht_get () records the key pointer (the LRU touch) and returns a preset value (what cache_add looks up); qdata_save_agg_htable_to_list () counts the dump; qdata_copy_agg_hkey () callocs and counts, qdata_free_agg_hkey () counts only (the flush scenario names static keys); db_private_*_release () are malloc/realloc/free.
